meta.title: Comic Story Studio
meta.description: Turns any topic into a 110–135s vertical comic short video where pictures tell the story: generated line art traced stroke by stroke, speech bubbles composited in code, single-voice narration with burned-in subtitles. Bundles the comic-story-video skill (audio leads + ten hard rules + an eight-panel sample) and the Python stroke engine (whiteboard-animator). Tools: comic_check mechanical pre-flight (only blocks what breaks the run), comic_prompts image-gen checklist with a prompt-fingerprint ledger, comic_produce background production (TTS → bubbles → boards → stroke rendering → vertical compose), comic_verify artifact verification (frame sampling + audio check), comic_doctor environment doctor (Python/ffmpeg/apiz, auto-fix). Images default to apiz flare image-to-image with the style anchor (~19 credits each); narration defaults to apiz MiniMax. The sidebar workbench has a four-stage pipeline view (story → images → produce → accept), scene archive cards, contact sheet and final video player.
